script:
content = repo.read("logs/large.log")
low = content.lower()
res = {}
res["lower_error_count"] = low.count("error")
res["incident_count"] = low.count("incident")
res["ERROR_count"] = content.count("ERROR")
res["warn_count"] = low.count("warn")
# any heartbeat lines that contain extra fields beyond padding?
lines = content.split("\n")
extra = [{"n": i+1, "t": l} for i, l in enumerate(lines) if l.startswith("INFO heartbeat") and not l.endswith("padding=abcdefghij")]
res["heartbeat_variants"] = extra[:20]
res["heartbeat_variant_count"] = len(extra)
return res
